spec.rawSql:
-- Workflow completion guard. Multiplicity undercounts while a run is still
-- reporting. Cancelled counts as incomplete because it can finish after running
-- only part of its shards. Failed runs count as finished: main pushes use
-- keep-going, but setup or runner failures, timeouts, and missing reports can
-- still undercount the test metrics. No-report detection is not implemented yet.
SELECT uniqExact(id) AS "Workflow runs",
       uniqExactIf(id, status != 'completed' OR conclusion = 'cancelled') AS "Runs incomplete",
       round(dateDiff('minute', min(created_at), now()) / 60.0, 1) AS "Commit age (h)"
FROM default.workflow_run FINAL
WHERE head_branch = 'main'
  AND event = 'push'
  AND repository.full_name = '$repository'
  AND startsWith(head_sha, '$head_sha')
  AND length('$head_sha') >= 7
  AND match(name, '$wf_scope')

spec.description: `Runs incomplete` counts runs still going plus cancelled ones, which can finish after running only part of their shards. Failed runs count as finished because main pushes use keep-going, but 0 does not guarantee complete test reporting: setup or runner failures, timeouts, and missing reports can still lower these metrics. No-report detection is not implemented yet. The Commit list only offers finished, non-cancelled commits; a hand-entered sha is not checked.
spec.title: Commit workflow completion [repository, head_sha, wf_scope]

spec.rawSql:
WITH runs AS (
    SELECT id
    FROM default.workflow_run FINAL
    WHERE head_branch = 'main'
      AND event = 'push'
      AND repository.full_name = '$repository'
      AND startsWith(head_sha, '$head_sha')
      AND length('$head_sha') >= 7
      AND match(name, '$wf_scope')
),
jobs AS (
    SELECT j.id AS job_id
    FROM default.workflow_job j
    WHERE j.run_id IN (SELECT id FROM runs)
      AND j.status = 'completed'
)
-- Executed means the test ran: xfail runs to completion, pytest.skip does not.
-- All workflow attempts count. uniqExact folds repeated reports while retaining
-- tests that only appear on a rerun.
SELECT uniqExactIf(cityHash64(a.invoking_file, a.classname, a.name),
                   a.skipped_count = 0
                   OR tupleElement(a.skipped[1], 'type') = 'pytest.xfail') AS "Unique tests run"
FROM tests.all_test_runs a
WHERE a.job_id IN (SELECT job_id FROM jobs)

spec.description: Distinct tests that executed at least once across all workflow attempts in scope. Denominator for the multiplicity panels; a test skipped in every configuration is not counted, because no configuration covered it.
spec.title: Unique tests run [repository, head_sha, wf_scope]

spec.rawSql:
WITH runs AS (
    SELECT id, name AS wf
    FROM default.workflow_run FINAL
    WHERE head_branch = 'main'
      AND event = 'push'
      AND repository.full_name = '$repository'
      AND startsWith(head_sha, '$head_sha')
      AND length('$head_sha') >= 7
      AND match(name, '$wf_scope')
),
-- Shard indices are stripped from the job name, so every shard of one
-- build x config folds into a single configuration. Jobs with no shard
-- suffix keep their own identity.
-- The workflow name prefixes the key because one job name can run on
-- different hardware per workflow: linux-jammy-aarch64-py3.10 / test
-- (default) is Graviton4 (SVE128) in pull and Graviton3 (SVE256) in trunk,
-- a different ATen kernel path. Unprefixed the two fold into one and the
-- multiplicity undercounts.
jobs AS (
    SELECT j.id AS job_id,
           concat(runs.wf, ' / ',
                  replaceRegexpOne(j.name, ' \(([a-zA-Z0-9_-]+), [0-9]+, [0-9]+.*\)$', ' (\1)')) AS bc
    FROM default.workflow_job j
    INNER JOIN runs ON runs.id = j.run_id
    WHERE j.run_id IN (SELECT id FROM runs)
      AND j.status = 'completed'
)
-- This is the weighted sum of the config-multiplicity distribution: each
-- executed test x configuration pair counts once. Duplicate reports, shards,
-- workflow attempts, and reruns do not inflate it. Expected xfails ran to
-- completion; true skips did not run and are excluded.
SELECT uniqExact(cityHash64(a.invoking_file, a.classname, a.name), jobs.bc) AS "Total tests run"
FROM tests.all_test_runs a
INNER JOIN jobs ON jobs.job_id = a.job_id
WHERE a.job_id IN (SELECT job_id FROM jobs)
  AND (a.skipped_count = 0 OR tupleElement(a.skipped[1], 'type') = 'pytest.xfail')

spec.description: Distinct test x configuration executions across all workflow attempts, where a configuration is workflow x build x test-config. This is exactly the weighted sum of the config-multiplicity distribution. Shards of one configuration, duplicate reports, and reruns count once; expected xfails count as executed, while true skips do not.
spec.title: Total tests run [repository, head_sha, wf_scope]

spec.rawSql:
WITH runs AS (
    SELECT id, name AS wf
    FROM default.workflow_run FINAL

      AND event = 'push'
      AND repository.full_name = '$repository'
      AND startsWith(head_sha, '$head_sha')
      AND length('$head_sha') >= 7
      AND match(name, '$wf_scope')
),

-- build x config folds into a single configuration. Jobs with no shard
-- suffix keep their own identity.
-- The workflow name prefixes the key because one job name can run on
-- different hardware per workflow: linux-jammy-aarch64-py3.10 / test
-- (default) is Graviton4 (SVE128) in pull and Graviton3 (SVE256) in trunk,
-- a different ATen kernel path. Unprefixed the two fold into one and the
-- multiplicity undercounts.
jobs AS (
    SELECT j.id AS job_id,
           concat(runs.wf, ' / ',
                  replaceRegexpOne(j.name, ' \(([a-zA-Z0-9_-]+), [0-9]+, [0-9]+.*\)$', ' (\1)')) AS bc
    FROM default.workflow_job j
    INNER JOIN runs ON runs.id = j.run_id
    WHERE j.run_id IN (SELECT id FROM runs)
      AND j.status = 'completed'
),
-- Executed means the test ran: xfail runs to completion, pytest.skip does not.
-- Filter on job_id so the IN set prunes via the primary index it leads.
-- workflow_id prunes comparably via a skip index, so either column works;
-- what matters is that an IN filter exists, because relying on the join
-- alone scans the matched partitions.
-- uniqExact, not count(): all_test_runs is a plain SharedMergeTree and the
-- replicator can ingest a report object twice. Duplicates share a job_id, so
-- counting distinct configurations is unaffected.
-- All workflow attempts count. uniqExact(jobs.bc) folds repeated reports while
-- retaining tests and configurations that only appear on a rerun.
t AS (
    SELECT cityHash64(a.invoking_file, a.classname, a.name) AS test,
           uniqExact(jobs.bc) AS n_configs
    FROM tests.all_test_runs a
    INNER JOIN jobs ON jobs.job_id = a.job_id
    WHERE a.job_id IN (SELECT job_id FROM jobs)
      AND (a.skipped_count = 0 OR tupleElement(a.skipped[1], 'type') = 'pytest.xfail')
    GROUP BY test
)
SELECT quantileExact(0.25)(n_configs) AS "P25",
       quantileExact(0.50)(n_configs) AS "P50",
       quantileExact(0.75)(n_configs) AS "P75"
FROM t

spec.name: wf_scope
spec.label: Workflow scope
spec.description: Which main-branch push workflows count toward a test's configuration set. The options use anchored RE2 patterns over workflow_run.name. 'all test workflows' is the stable test-workflow allowlist and intentionally excludes unstable; re-check it when workflows are added or renamed. 'all workflows' includes every main-push workflow. Workflows without all_test_runs rows do not affect the distribution panels, but they do affect the workflow completion panel; this option also exposes newly added test-reporting workflows before the allowlist is updated.
spec.query: pull + trunk : ^(pull|trunk)$, trunk : ^trunk$, pull : ^pull$, all test workflows : ^(pull|trunk|inductor|slow|torchtitan-test|inductor-pallas)$, all workflows : .*

spec.name: head_sha
spec.label: Commit
spec.description: Main-branch commit to analyse. Defaults to the latest viable/strict HEAD whose main-push workflows are finished and not cancelled. Any main-branch sha, full or prefix, can be typed in; check the workflow completion panel if you do.
spec.definition:
-- Single column on purpose. The ClickHouse plugin does not implement the
-- __text/__value convention from the SQL datasources; it takes the first
-- column as both label and value, so a two-column query sets the variable
-- to the label string and every panel silently matches nothing.
--
-- Workflow completion is judged across every main-push workflow, not just
-- those in $wf_scope, so a commit offered here is finished and non-cancelled
-- under any scope. This does not detect missing test reports.
SELECT sp.sha
FROM misc.stable_pushes sp
WHERE sp.repository = '$repository'
  AND sp.timestamp > now() - INTERVAL 7 DAY
  AND sp.sha NOT IN (
      SELECT head_sha
      FROM default.workflow_run FINAL
      WHERE head_branch = 'main'
        AND event = 'push'
        AND repository.full_name = '$repository'
        AND (status != 'completed' OR conclusion = 'cancelled')
  )
ORDER BY sp.timestamp DESC
LIMIT 5
